Editorials, news items, conference listings without sufficient methods or results, and unsourced narrative claims are excluded from evidentiary synthesis but may trigger anchor searches.

inclusion_criteria: Record is available on or before 2024-12-31 after reconciling online-first, issue, correction, registry-update, regulatory effective, and database dates.

Registered trials and FDA regulatory records are eligible when they address LRRK2-targeted intervention, target engagement, biomarker performance, safety, approval status, or translational failure.

Null, negative, conflicting, failed-replication, correction, retraction, incomplete-penetrance, population-limited, and safety findings are eligible regardless of whether they support the leading mechanism.
